rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone has completed a degree or course and graduated.

example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 bat1 jip6 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone who has completed a course of study, with the school level supplied by context.

example.traditional: 我哋公司請咗一個畢業生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 cing2 zo2 jat1 go3 bat1 jip6 sang1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a university graduate rather than a graduate from another level of school.

example.english: This job is ideal for a university graduate who has just graduated.
example.traditional: 呢份工好適合啱啱畢業嘅大學畢業生。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 gung1 hou2 sik1 hap6 ngaam1 ngaam1 bat1 jip6 ge3 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 sang1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a high school or secondary-school graduate.

example.english: A high-school graduate can apply for this course.
example.traditional: 中學畢業生可以報讀呢個課程。
example.jyutping: zung1 hok6 bat1 jip6 sang1 ho2 ji5 bou3 duk6 ni1 go3 fo3 cing4

rows.note: Use this for a marked measuring cup or similar container used to measure quantities.

example.english: Use a graduate to measure the ingredients when making a cake.
example.traditional: 整蛋糕要用量杯量材料。
example.jyutping: zing2 daan6 gou1 jiu3 jung6 loeng4 bui1 loeng4 coi4 liu6
